display_name: KYE Connector Contract — change-approval importer (generic ITSM shape)
description: CONTRACT (schema + mapping) — NOT a live runtime — for importing an approved change record from an ITSM tool so the approval it carries can be resolved against the KYE authority chain before a production action is admitted.

bound_standards.role: the change-authority assessment whose outcome this connector imports

binding_chain: approved change record -> authority: an imported approval is a claim about who authorised what, and is admitted only once it resolves to a principal holding the decision right for that action class. An unresolved approver makes the record evidence of a request, never of an authority.

external_dependency.what: The ITSM tool itself. KYE does not run it and does not hold its credentials.
external_dependency.why_deferred: A live import needs a tenant-held credential that is not in-repo (§0.29 — an external dependency is the only admissible incompleteness).

honest_scope: KYE governs whether an imported approval may authorise an action. It does not verify that the change described in the ticket is a good idea, and it does not replace the ITSM tool's own workflow.
